law: This sample code project must be run on a physical device.
Before you run the sample code project in Xcode, check to be sure your device has iOS 13 or later or iPadOS 13 or later installed.
Use the CallKit framework to integrate native VoIP calling.
Use CallKit to integrate your calling services with other call-related apps in the system.
CallKit also responds appropriately to system-level behaviors, such as Do Not Disturb.
In addition to handling calls, you can use a Call Directory app extension to provide caller ID information and a list of blocked numbers associated with your service.
With a person’s permission, an installed health research app that uses entitlements may collect Speech Metrics data while your CallKit app is in use.
The system may use that information to indicate communication with that person as a suggestion in the Journal app, or in other apps that use the framework.
Call-related actions route through your provider and its delegate, which you use to communicate with your service.
